fusions.name: Flattening Arc
fusions.desc: Brings the flat of the blade down across everything within 3 tiles ahead of you, dealing 12 damage and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Anvil Stroke
fusions.desc: An overhead stroke that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Second Tempering
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Peened with Every Blow
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
